| <nowiki>Krayt Dragon Bones & Imperial Justice</nowiki> || Game text || <nowiki>If opponent is generating at least 4 more Force than you, deploy on a location to cancel all Force generation at that location. Also, each opponent's destiny draw, you do the following: (0) Put top used card in hand; (1) lose 1 Force; (2) activate 1 Force; (3) lose this Effect; (4) retrieve 1 Force; (5) deploy a character for free; (6+) nothing.</nowiki><ref name="15_191-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Krayt-Dragon-Bones-Imperial-Justice.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>If opponent is generating at least 4 more Force than you, deploy on a location to cancel all Force generation at that location. Also, each opponent's destiny draw, you do the following: (0) Put top used card in hand; (1) lose 1 Force; (2) activate 1 Force; (3) lose this Effect; (4) retrieve 1 Force; (5) deploy a character for free; (6+) nothing.</nowiki><ref name="15_191-remastered">[[:File:RG-GEMP-Krayt-Dragon-Bones-Imperial-Justice.png]]</ref>

| <nowiki>Name The System!</nowiki> || Lore || <nowiki>Senator Organa, pressured into revealing the location of her Rebellious operations, eventually lied to Tarkin in order to buy precious time for her rebel friends.</nowiki><ref name="15_192-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Name-The-System.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>Senator Organa pressured into revealing the location of her Rebellious operations eventually lied to Tarkin in order to buy precious time for her rebel friends.</nowiki><ref name="15_192-remastered">[[:File:RG-GEMP-Name-The-System.png]]</ref>

| <nowiki>Not Worth The Trouble</nowiki> || Lore || <nowiki>The lesson that Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba failed to learn was that when a Jedi wants to buy you a drink, it's usually best to take him up on the offer.</nowiki><ref name="15_193-original">[[:File:RG-C1-Not-Worth-The-Trouble.jpg]]</ref> || <nowiki>The lesson that Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba failed to learn was that when a Jedi wants to buy you a drink it's usually best to take him up on the offer.</nowiki><ref name="15_193-remastered">[[:File:RG-GEMP-Not-Worth-The-Trouble.png]]</ref>
|-
